name: new-route
tagline_zh: 说句“加个页面”，它立刻生成路由、组件、测试和 Story，连 i18n 键都备好——不用再手动建五个文件。
tagline_en: Say "add a page" and get route, component, test, Story, and i18n keys in one shot—no more hand-creating five files.
desc_en: Scaffold a new route with its page component, test, story, and optional i18n keys. Use this skill whenever the user asks to "create a route", "add a new page", "scaffold /dashboard", "wire up a new route under _public+ or _session+", or anything that implies adding a file under `app/routes/` with a matching `app/pages/{Group}/{PascalName}Page/` folder.
why_zh: 同类只建路由，它连测试和 Story 一起搭好，且自动匹配 _public+ 或 _session+ 。
why_en: Others just scaffold routes; this one also adds test and Story, auto-matching _public+ or _session+ prefixes—saves you.
